title: Tinian IBB Facility Management

THIS IS A MARKET RESEARCH/SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE SEEKING INFORMATION ONLY. THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION/REQUEST FOR QUOTE. THIS SHOULD NOT BE CONSTRUED AS A COMMITMENT BY THE GOVERNMENT TO ISSUE A SOLICITATION OR ULTIMATELY AWARD A CONTRACT, NOR DOES IT RESTRICT THE GOVERNMENT TO A PARTICULAR ACQUISITION APPROACH OR OTHERWISE REIMBURSE RESPONDENTS FOR ANY COSTS INCURRED IN PREPARATION OF A RESPONSE TO THIS NOTICE. 

 356 ETSG is seeking sources for a potential upcoming facility maintenance services requirement on Tinian, Northern Mariana Islands.Vendors with capability to provide facility maintenance services on Tinian should review the attached DRAFT Performance Work Statement and offer any feedback regarding suitability for the area or other relevant suggestions.Additionally, please provide the following company information: 

 1.    Name of company 

 2. Point of Contact 

 3. Email address 

 4. Phone number 

 5. Company's business size for NAICS 561210 and CAGE/UEI codes 

 All responses must include 356 ETSG/CONS org box, 356ETSG.CONS.Team@us.af.mil
